comments.body:
The https://colab.research.google.com/github/google/iree/blob/main/colab/tflite_text_classification.ipynb notebook shows a similar error (and that worked at some point).

```
CompilerToolError: Error invoking IREE compiler tool iree-translate
Diagnostics:
<stdin>:13:11: error: 'tosa.gather' op operand #1 must be 2D tensor of 32-bit signless integer values, but got '!hal.buffer_view'
    %10 = "tosa.gather"(%9, %arg0) : (tensor<1x10003x16xf32>, tensor<1x256xi32>) -> tensor<1x256x16xf32>
          ^
```

Both are missing the --iree-input-type=tosa flag (input_type=tosa in python).

The input pipeline in the compiler has a bug: the validation pass that verifies only legal input is provided should be catching this and telling you to include the flag, but it isn't. I think this happened when Mahesh split the code up. The error is coming because the tosa op is getting through unconverted and being treated like a custom op -- which it is not (it falls verification when bufferized).

Also, to save you some time:

* Quantized convolution codegen is still being implemented (actively - shouldn't be long but does not work now) -- so float only
* Performance work on depthwise conv and friends is scheduled but not done beyond POCs. It will work but is not nearly as efficient as it should be.

>

I think this happened when Mahesh split the code up. The error is coming because the tosa op is getting through unconverted and being treated like a custom op -- which it is not (it falls verification when bufferized).

Ah, thanks for pointing that out! Adding the `input_type=tosa` option does fix that notebook. I can send a PR tomorrow to update the notebook + docs.

issue.body:
Hello,

I tried to use iree-translate executable generated after https://google.github.io/iree/building-from-source/getting-started/
for compiling mobile net V2 TFLite model. (Since the iree-translate form pip package didn't work https://github.com/google/iree/issues/6690)

Though the conversion from .tflite to .mlir is successful using iree-import-tflite , conversion from .mlir to .vmfb failed..

COMMAND:
iree/tools/iree-translate --iree-mlir-to-vm-bytecode-module --iree-hal-target-backends=vmvx ../mobilenet_v2.mlir -o ../mobilenet_v2.vmfb 2>&1 | tee | grep -E "error|fail"

Model : mobilenet_v2_1.0_224.tflite (https://storage.googleapis.com/download.tensorflow.org/models/tflite_11_05_08/mobilenet_v2_1.0_224.tgz)

Logs(Only error):
../mobilenet_v2.mlir:110:12: error: 'tosa.conv2d' op operand #0 must be unranked.tensor of number values or 4D tensor of number values, but got '!hal.buffer_view'
../mobilenet_v2.mlir:1:1: error: conversion from source -> vm failed

issue.body:
See https://github.com/google/iree/issues/6691

When @MaheshRavishankar split the input pipeline source code, the verification passes stopped enforcing that no high level ops survive to the main pipeline. It should do so and raise an appropriate error.
